lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Thirteen distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is broader in the mid-section and becomes narrower and more compressed as the lines approach the anterior shoulder and posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first three anterior lines and the final three posterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the mid-torso height. Several central lines exhibit breaks or thinning at the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of approximately four white spots is visible on the lower haunch, situated between the posterior-most vertical line and the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch exhibit a diagonal linear alignment roughly parallel to the upper hind limb angle.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial markings are present as spots on the cheek. A prominent white patch is visible at the base of the throat. Distinct white bands are present on the upper regions of all visible limbs.
